# anthropic_rbac_role_permissions (Data Source)

Lists the permissions a Claude Enterprise RBAC role grants (`/v1/organizations/rbac_roles/{id}/permissions`). Roles are defined by Anthropic and are read-only through the API. A `capability_access_all` or `capability_access_all_ga` action is a blanket grant that covers many product features.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_rbac_roles" "all" {}

data "anthropic_rbac_role_permissions" "first" {
  role_id = data.anthropic_rbac_roles.all.roles[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) Identifier of the RBAC role, for example from `anthropic_rbac_roles`.

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (Attributes List) Permissions the role grants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Action the permission grants on the resource, for example `chat`, `use` or `grant`.
- `connector_id` (String) Connector the permission applies to (connector kinds only).
- `organization_id` (String) Organization the permission applies to (`organization` only).
- `resource_type` (String) Kind of resource: `organization`, `connector_tool`, `connector_scope`, `connector` or `all_connectors`.
- `scope` (String) OAuth scope, possibly server-encoded (`connector_scope` only).
- `tool_name` (String) Published connector tool name, possibly server-encoded (`connector_tool` only).
